description: Keller Williams El Salvador is part of the international Keller Williams network, providing real estate services for investors and home buyers in El Salvador. They focus on innovation, agent education, and offer expertise in luxury beachfront, vacation homes, residential properties, and commercial real estate, especially in high-growth regions like La Libertad and San Salvador.[1][2]

Realtor El Salvador is a bilingual real estate agency offering property rentals and sales throughout El Salvador, specializing in serving domestic and international clients in both English and Spanish. The site features an agent login portal, property comparisons, and services for real estate professionals.[14]

Goodlife El Salvador is a local real estate consultancy focused on curating investment tours and offering tailored property advice for buyers and investors interested in El Salvador. Their specialization is in personalized, immersive client experiences and assisting with real estate investments, particularly for foreigners and retirees.[15]

Century 21 Global connects buyers and sellers with a network of real estate agents and brokers in El Salvador. The site offers property listings for sale and rent, with an emphasis on international clients seeking residential and commercial properties in the region.[8][16]

El Salvador Surf Real Estate is a boutique agency specializing in beachfront and surf property sales along El Salvador's Pacific coast. The agency primarily serves international buyers looking for investment and vacation properties in the country's top surf destinations.

AISA is one of El Salvador's leading property management firms, providing comprehensive real estate administration services, including vendor management, equipment maintenance, security oversight, and regulatory compliance for residential and commercial properties.

company_name: Tu Casa El Salvador - Henry Zavaleta (RE/MAX Capital)
description: Operated by Henry Zavaleta under the RE/MAX Capital franchise, this site offers personalized real estate services for buying, selling, and renting homes and land. Specializes in international connections and leveraging RE/MAX's global network for maximum property exposure and client support.

RE/MAX Central, based in San Salvador, is part of the international RE/MAX franchise network. The office offers a full spectrum of real estate services, including residential, commercial, and investment properties, with a strong emphasis on professionalism, global marketing, and client service in El Salvador.[12][20]

A leading real estate developer in El Salvador, specializing in high-end, innovative residential, corporate, and mixed-use projects. They are known for creating lifestyle-centric communities and landmark office buildings. Specialization: Real Estate Development, Investment.

One of the largest and most influential real estate developers in Central America. In El Salvador, they are responsible for major shopping centers (like Metrocentro and Multiplaza), corporate centers, and residential complexes. Specialization: Real Estate Development, Corporate Real Estate Management, Property Management.

A major developer with over 50 years of experience, primarily focused on creating large-scale residential communities and commercial centers across El Salvador. Specialization: Real Estate Development, Sales.

A franchise of the international CityMax real estate network, offering a wide range of brokerage services. Their website is a key portal for property listings. Specialization: Brokerage, Sales, Rentals, Property Management.

A leading law firm in El Salvador with a dedicated real estate department. They provide legal counsel on property acquisition, development projects, leasing agreements, and real estate litigation. Specialization: Real Estate Law, Finance.

company_name: CASALCO (Cámara Salvadoreña de la Industria de la Construcción)
description: The Salvadoran Chamber of the Construction Industry. While not a company, it is the most important industry association, representing developers, builders, and suppliers. Its website and publications are a key source of market data and member directories. Specialization: Industry Association, Market Data.

Specializes in property marketing, sales, and Airbnb management. Offers services for buying, selling, and managing real estate, including beachfront homes, city properties, and investment opportunities. Expertise in both local and international markets, with a focus on maximizing rental income and investment returns.[3]

Global leader in commercial real estate services, offering real estate management, strategic project services, property marketing, occupier services, landlord and tenant representation, and capital markets expertise. Provides research and insights on the Salvadoran market.[4]

Connects clients with pre-vetted professionals in finance, legal, and real estate services. Specializes in investment, property sourcing, legal support, and maximizing ROI for foreign and local investors. Focus on simplifying the process for English-speaking clients.[2]
Diversified business group with a strong real estate division. Specializes in commercial real estate, including office buildings, shopping centers, and hotels.
Regional law firm with a strong real estate law practice. Provides legal advisory, due diligence, and transaction support for real estate investments and developments.
